description: Decorative paper carrying a swirled, multi-coloured pattern, sometimes pasted up as a doubled sheet for paste-downs. Cockerell warns that the stock is usually weak and unfit for end papers unless it is genuinely tough and durable.
name: marbled paper

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (D. Appleton, 1901), Internet Archive
